messages:
Amy (People Ops): Quick heads-up — final onsite for Senior Backend (take-home + onsite) is this Thu 10am PT. Need quick confirmations from the panel and a couple logistics checks. Candidate requested ASL interpreter and a 30-min extension for the coding exercise. Can you respond with ✅ if you can make the whole slot, or 🚫 if you can't? If you can cover only part of it, say which segment (take-home review / system design / coding).

Jordan Lee: ✅ will join entire panel. can I get the take-home artifacts ahead of time?

Amy (People Ops): @Jordan — sent take-home link to your calendar invite and GH gist. also added interpreter placeholder on the invite.

Samir Patel: I can do coding + take-home review but might need to duck at 11:15 PT for another call. happy to handoff system design.

Elena Ramos: I can cover system design if Samir needs the duck-out. ✅ system design only otherwise.

Priya Nair: I'll be ~10 minutes late (back-to-back). can someone start the coding section and bring me up to speed? 🚶‍♀️

Jordan Lee: no problem — I can start the coding section and pause for Priya to join.

Amy (People Ops): Thanks all. Two quick operational notes: 1) Please submit your rubric within 24 hours after the interview (we use these fields). 2) For ASL interpreter — Ops booked via vendor, interpreter will join Zoom 10m before start; if you need special mic setup let me know.

Amy (People Ops): Rubric quick template (paste into the rubric form or DM me if you want a CSV):
```
- Candidate: [name]
- Role: Senior Backend Engineer
- Take-home (1-5): [score] — notes
- Coding (1-5): [score] — notes
- System design (1-5): [score] — notes
- Communication & collaboration (1-5): [score] — notes
- Recommendation: [Yes / Maybe / No]
- Confidence (low/med/high): [what level]
```

Samir Patel: tiny Q — for the take-home scoring, do we weight coding > design by default? want to be consistent across panels.

Amy (People Ops): Good Q. We ask interviewers to score each area independently and then write a short recommendation. Hiring team applies weight (coding 40%, design 35%, take-home 15%, comms 10%) for this role — but the final call looks at the written recommendation too. I'll paste that into the invite notes.

Elena Ramos: Thanks — can we also keep an async debrief thread after the onsite? sometimes people can't make the live debrief.

Interview Bot: Reminder scheduled — post-interview debrief thread will be created automatically and invitations to submit rubrics will be emailed to panelists 5m after the candidate leaves.

Priya Nair: Great, thanks. Also FYI I prefer Google Docs comments if I add notes during debrief.

Amy (People Ops): Noted. Final ask: if anyone needs a backup for their slot, reply with the segment you can cover and who you'd prefer as backup. I'll update the invite by EOD. :thumbsup:
